Name: Lina Inverse (from the Slayers) Replaces Abigail (Content Patcher)
Author: waffletoast215
Description:
This mod replaces Abigail with the beautiful sorcery genius, Lina Inverse from the Slayers! Includes both regular and beach versions! You'd better download, or she'll really cause some trouble!

﻿-all of Abigail's sprites have been replaced with ones of the Dragon Spooker, Lina Inverse!
﻿-Her wedding outfit is based on Lina's "Bridal Banquet" skin from Langrisser mobile!
﻿-Her swimsuit and pajamas are based on the ones seen in Slayers: the Motion Picture!
﻿-A few of her dialogue lines are replaced! 
        -NEW: adds winter clothing based on a piece of official promotional art!

Use SMAPI/Content Patcher to use this mod!


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271?tab=files&file_id=51404]You can use this mod to change her name to match!
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2668?tab=files&file_id=11023]Here is the UI mod shown in these screenshots!﻿
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4154]Here is the clothing mod I am using in some screenshots!﻿
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17460]Here is the hair mod I am using in some screenshots!﻿
[/url]﻿
Contains both edited Abigail sprites and original sprites, all made by me.
Background of the preview thumbnail is from the opening to season 1 of the Slayers.

Enjoy! Please do not repost my sprites/use them in other projects without permission!
